sections.title: Short title and commencement.
sections.content:
(1) This Act may be called the Sikh Gurdwaras (Supplementary-) Act, 1925.

(2) It shall come into force on the date^1 appointed by the ^2 ^3(State Government), under sub-section (3) of section 1 of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925.

sections.title: Validation of certain provisions of Punjab Act 8 of 1925.
sections.content: The Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925 (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), shall so far as it adds to or takes from the jurisdiction of the ^1High Court of ^2(Punjab) or prescribes the procedure of the said Court, be as valid as if it had been passed by the Indian Legislature.
